name: BM-8-24
description: The BM-8-24 is a Soviet MLRS created during the Great Patriotic War. It is a futher development of the BM-8-36 combat vehicle and uses similar ammunition. These combat vehicles were mass-produced at the Kompressor and Krasnaya Presnya factories on T-40 and T-60 tank chassis. Instead of a turret, a launcher with M-8 rockets—a modified version of RS-82 aircraft rockets—was installed. The first T-60 tank-based vehicles arrived at the frontline in November 1941, and a total of 111 BM-8-24 MLRS were produced. However, by spring 1943, these vehicles had been decommissioned due to extensive wear. Nevertheless, the launchers were not retired. Several M-8-24 launchers, along with additional equipment, were removed from tank chassis and installed on trucks. This weapon was used in this form for some time. The BM-8-24 was introduced in Update 1.53 "Firestorm" . In terms of gameplay, the vehicle lacks the firepower to destroy enemy armored vehicles. Its rockets contain only 600 grams of explosives and can penetrate up to 9 mm of armor. This is only sufficient to destroy unarmored vehicles, such as early AAAs or SPGs.
